hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Picture the sorted data split into four equal groups. The IQR measures how wide the middle two groups are.
The quartiles are already worked out for you. The IQR is the gap between them.
Use the given values $Q3 = 9$ and $Q1 = 3$, and subtract the lower quartile from the upper: $9 - 3$.
$9 - 3 = 6$, so with these quartiles the IQR is $6$.

explanation: The interquartile range is the distance from the lower quartile to the upper quartile.
The problem gives the quartiles to use: $Q1 = 3$ and $Q3 = 9$.
Subtract the lower from the upper: $9 - 3 = 6$, so the IQR is $6$.
